status_summary: DOT proposed on 2025-10-30 to reinstate hearing procedures for discretionary aviation unfair or deceptive practice rulemakings. The final rule was published on 2026-07-01 and took effect on 2026-07-31, restoring the 2020 due process protections, including neutral hearing officers and formal findings of fact.
